description: Is this signed audit export intact? Returns intact or broken_at for a supplied signed export; use it to check a gate_export_audit_proof export rather than retrieve audit rows. Recomputes the chain and project signature; broken_at is a one-based row position. Does not approve actions or change permissions.

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

project_id.description: The project id from project creation on the setup endpoint (/mcp/setup), e.g. p1a2b3...

proof.description: The full signed export from gate_export_audit_proof

name: gate_verify_audit_proof
title: Verify a signed audit export
